predictions.prediction_text: 10 yr is expected to hover ~4.3% because of tariff worries and heavy Treasury supply.

predictions.prediction_text: This Sept cut is expected to be a hawkish cut (25bp) followed by more cuts in 2026 as tariff effects start to fade.
predictions.condition: if Fed trims the policy rate 25bp in September

predictions.prediction_text: Fed cut would lower MMF yields, which could unlock some money out of cash over time.

predictions.expected_result: consumer demand and inflationary pressures from wealth effects will moderate over time following the gradual decline in asset prices.
